title: Barn Safety Assessment
description: Free Barn Safety Assessment template for agriculture you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, safety features, approval & sign-off.

Hazards And Controls

HazardWho / what is at riskExisting controlsLSRiskAdditional controls / owner
Fire in hay or equipment storageWorkers, animalsNo smoking, electrical inspection , extingui shers, hay moisture checks
Falls from lofts and openingsWorkersGuard hay holes, secure ladders, lighting
Animal handling injuriesWorkersHandling f acilities, training, calm handling
Manure gas (hydrogen sulphide, methane)WorkersVentilatio n, no entry to pits without pr ecautions
Electrical faultsWorkers, animalsInspection , RCDs, protected wiring
Slips and tripsWorkersDrainage, lighting, clear walkways
Structural collapseWorkersInspect roof and beams, repairs

Risk Rating Guide (L = Likelihood 1-5, S = Severity 1-5, Risk = L X S)

1. 1-4 Low: manage by routine procedures.

2. 5-9 Medium: add controls where reasonably practicable and monitor.

3. 10-16 High: do not start or continue until controls reduce the risk; senior approval

needed.

4. 17-25 Extreme: stop work; redesign or eliminate the hazard.

Safety Features

☐ Fire exits clear and extinguishers serviced

☐ Lighting adequate

☐ Ventilation working

☐ Electrical panels and cables safe from rodents and moisture

☐ Emergency contact numbers displayed

☐ Evacuation plan includes animals where safe
